title: A Piecewise-Linear Activation Function for Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.31666v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coordinate networks with ReLU activations perform poorly on implicit neural representation tasks, and the activations that address this, such as sinusoids and Gabor wavelets, all leave the piecewise-linear function class, so it remains unclear which property of ReLU is at fault. We introduce JaSIN, a family of bounded piecewise-linear activations that interpolates between ReLU and a piecewise-linear sinusoid without any the use of transcendental operation. Our results show that a bounded range improves image reconstruction PSNR on average by 0.06 dB, a single bump 3.29 dB, and centering that bump a further 3.64 dB. The oscillation count improves 6.30 dB more, raising ReLU from 24.0 to 37.3 dB on Kodak images, placing third over eleven activations, within 1.3 dB of the state-of-the-art, though beyond four oscillations the reconstruction collapses. translated_title: 用于隐式神经表示的分段线性激活函数
translated_abstract: 使用ReLU激活函数的坐标网络在隐式神经表示（INR）任务上表现不佳，而解决这一问题的激活函数（如正弦函数和Gabor小波）都脱离了分段线性函数类，因此目前仍不清楚ReLU的哪个性质是问题所在。我们提出了JaSIN，这是一族有界的分段线性激活函数，它在ReLU与分段线性正弦函数之间进行插值，且无需使用任何超越运算。我们的结果表明：有界范围平均可将图像重建PSNR提高0.06 dB，单个凸起可提高3.29 dB，将该凸起居中可再提高3.64 dB。引入振荡可再多提高6.30 dB，将ReLU在Kodak图像上的表现从24.0 dB提升至37.3 dB，在十一种激活函数中排名第三，与最先进方法的差距在1.3 dB以内，但当振荡次数超过四次时重建效果会崩溃。由于INR是在评估它的网格上进行拟合的，一个预激活值……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出JaSIN——一族介于ReLU与分段线性正弦之间的有界分段线性激活函数，通过引入有界范围、居中凸起和有限振荡，将ReLU在图像重建任务上的PSNR从24.0 dB提升至37.3 dB，在十一种激活函数中位居第三，接近最先进水平。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces JaSIN, a family of bounded piecewise-linear activations interpolating between ReLU and a piecewise-linear sinusoid, which progressively raises ReLU's image reconstruction PSNR from 24.0 to 37.3 dB through a bounded range, a centered bump, and limited oscillations, ranking third among eleven activations and approaching state-of-the-art performance.
